summary: After a real D3D9 GPU tile capture succeeds but LockRect, staging row pitch, or UnlockRect fails, retry through one budget-admitted full original D3D9 source readback before publishing the native D3D11 frame.

feature_contract.goal: Recover a late CPU staging failure in the authentic D3D9 tile capture by a properly budgeted full readback so native game menu-to-race frame copying cannot silently drop that valid game region.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Late LockRect, pitch, or UnlockRect failure in a successful GPU tile capture retries once from original D3D9 full source before native UpdateSubresource
If the full readback byte budget or actual transfer is unavailable no native frame is published and the original D3D9 game output remains intact
A successful tile uses cropped bytes but a fallback costs full-source bytes without inventing game or VR runtime proof
Required DX11 Fast, Backend Gate, Windows Build, OpenXR and HUD Inspector pass together on one exact SHA

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Destructive source-link regression finds ordered original GPU tile staging failure, full-source fallback and native region publication
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Missing budget, retry or tileSucceeded switch causes regression failure, while false native frame publication stays fail-closed
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 LockRect/staging captured original tile or admitted full source reaches D3D11 native game frame CopySubresourceRegion
